resource: USE_INTENT payload under ITEM_USE_V1 (fields 4 and 5 included)
allocation_impact: Capability 15 does not raise the USE_INTENT bound: the largest intent with field 4 and field 2 or 5 is 44 bytes, far below the existing 529-byte payload limit, and the decoder refuses any larger payload before parsing.
boundary_tests: max=529: a 529-byte USE_INTENT is accepted with capability 15 selected
max+1=530: a 530-byte USE_INTENT is refused with capability 15 selected
notes: Registered by ITEM-USE-WIRE-1 under ARCH-BATCH-ROOT-PACKETS-V1 §2.2 (D485). Mirrors max_payload_bytes of command type 2.
